tool.name: Normalize.shared
tool.description: Normalize the number of sequences per group to a specified level
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$otu' otu.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #if $otu.is_of_type("mothur.relabund"): #silent $mothur_args.append("relabund=otu.dat") #elif $otu.is_of_type("mothur.shared"): #silent $mothur_args.append("shared=otu.dat") #silent $mothur_args.append("makerelabund=" + str($makerelabund)) #end if #if $label: #silent $mothur_args.append("label=" + str(str($label).replace(",","-"))) #end if #if $groups: #silent $mothur_args.append("groups=" + str(str($groups).replace(",","-"))) #end if #if $method: #silent $mothur_args.append("method=" + str(str($method).replace(",","-"))) #end if
echo 'normalize.shared(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log

param.name: otu
param.label: shared,relabund - OTU Shared or Relabund file

param.name: makerelabund
param.label: makerelabund - convert a shared file to a relabund file before you normalize

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The normalize.shared_ command normalizes the number of sequences per group to a specified level. The input is a shared_ or relabund_ file.
.. _shared: https://mothur.org/wiki/shared_file/ .. _relabund: https://mothur.org/wiki/get.relabund/ .. _normalize.shared: https://mothur.org/wiki/normalize.shared/
